options.name: name
options.description: The credential name to validate the embedded credential name.

options.name: newline
options.description: Whether to add a trailing newline character to the end of the output, if not present.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: The timestamp to use to validate the V(not-after) timestamp that was used during encryption. Takes a timestamp specification in the format described in V(systemd.time(7\)).

options.name: transcode
options.description: Whether to transcode the output before returning it.

options.name: user
options.description: A user name or numeric UID when decrypting from a specific user context. If set to the special string V(self) it sets the user to the user of the calling process. Requires C(systemd) 256 or later.
